effect.name: GM RGB Rainbow
effect.desc: A full-spectrum rainbow generated from six different drivers: the layer's own luminance, a rotatable position axis, distance from a point, angle around a point, time, or a blend of luma and position. Hue range, cycles, phase and a separate hue shift let you dial in anything from a two-colour sweep to a tight prism band. The spectrum is then composited onto the source with a real blend mode. Built in layer space, so the gradient is part of the layer and moves with it.
